locations.note: Street thief Basim becomes a Hidden One in 9th-century Abbasid Baghdad during the Anarchy at Samarra.
The Valley of Memory expansion adds an explorable ninth-century AlUla region, including Hegra and the Valley of Stones.
The Round City is the caliphal heart of Baghdad in 861.
The House of Wisdom stands in the Abbasiyah district.
Basim's home town, where he starts as a street thief with Nehal and steals the artifact that draws the Hidden Ones' eye.
Alamut, the Hidden Ones’ fortress, is visited in story missions.

routes.name: Basim Ibn Ishaq
routes.note: A street thief flees Anbar for training at Alamut, hunts the Order through Baghdad, and returns to the besieged mountain fortress to learn what he really is.
